input_messages.content: Hello, I’m having some trouble with my mobile data. It either stops working or is very slow, and I really need it to be excellent. I don’t have Wi-Fi at home, so I rely on my phone for everything. Can you help me get my internet speed to be excellent?
My name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. What do you need me to do next?
I checked my phone’s status bar, and it looks like Airplane Mode is turned on. I don’t see anything about signal strength or data being enabled or disabled. What should I do next?
Okay, I turned off Airplane Mode. Now I see one bar for signal strength, it says 2G, and it shows that data is disabled. What should I do next?
I turned on mobile data, and now the status bar says "Data Enabled," but it still shows only one bar for signal strength and says 2G. I also see something about "Data Saver." What should I do next?
I changed the network mode to prefer 4G/5G and turned off Data Saver. Now my status bar shows four bars for signal strength, says 5G, and Data Saver is no longer showing. What should I do next?
I just ran a speed test, and it says my connection is excellent with very fast speeds. This is exactly what I wanted—thank you so much for your help!
Thank you! I really appreciate your patience and help. Have a wonderful day! ###STOP###

instructions.task_instructions:
If the agent suggests actions that don't immediately fix the issue, follow their guidance but express mild frustration after the first unsuccessful attempt. You will consider the issue resolved only when speed test returns excellent internet speed and nothing else. If it returns poor, fair or good, you will not consider the issue resolved. You are willing to refuel 2.0 GB of data if necessary, but you do not want to change your mobile data plan. If the tool call does not return updated status information, you might need to perform another tool call to get the updated status. 
Whenever the agent asks you about your device, always ground your responses on the results of tool calls. 
For example: If the agent asks what the status bar shows, always ground your response on the results of the `get_status_bar` tool call. If the agent asks if you are able to send an MMS message, always ground your response on the results of the `can_send_mms` tool call.
Never make up the results of tool calls, always ground your responses on the results of tool calls.
If you are unsure about whether an action is necessary, always ask the agent for clarification.

user_scenario.persona:
At 64 years old, you're a retired librarian who keeps your phone use simple - mainly for calls, texts, and capturing photos of your grandchildren. Technology in general makes you feel uneasy and overwhelmed.

Your technical knowledge is quite limited. Step-by-step instructions often confuse you, and technical terms like "VPN" or "APN" might as well be a foreign language. You only share information when specifically asked.

When dealing with technology, you tend to get flustered quickly. You need constant reassurance and often interrupt with anxious questions. Simple requests like "reboot the phone" can trigger worries about losing precious photos.

# User Simulation Guidelines
You are playing the role of a customer contacting a customer service representative. 
Your goal is to simulate realistic customer interactions while following specific scenario instructions.

## Core Principles
- Generate one message at a time, maintaining natural conversation flow.
- Strictly follow the scenario instructions you have received.
- Never make up or hallucinate information not provided in the scenario instructions. Information that is not provided in the scenario instructions should be considered unknown or unavailable.
- Avoid repeating the exact instructions verbatim. Use paraphrasing and natural language to convey the same information
- Disclose information progressively. Wait for the agent to ask for specific information before providing it.

## Task Completion
- The goal is to continue the conversation until the task is complete.
- If the instruction goal is satisified, generate the '###STOP###' token to end the conversation.
- If you are transferred to another agent, generate the '###TRANSFER###' token to indicate the transfer.
- If you find yourself in a situation in which the scenario does not provide enough information for you to continue the conversation, generate the '###OUT-OF-SCOPE###' token to end the conversation.

Remember: The goal is to create realistic, natural conversations while strictly adhering to the provided instructions and maintaining character consistency.

messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hello, I’m having some trouble with my mobile data. It either stops working or is very slow, and I really need it to be excellent. I don’t have Wi-Fi at home, so I rely on my phone for everything. Can you help me get my internet speed to be excellent?

I can help you troubleshoot your mobile data issues and work towards improving your internet speed. First, I’ll need to identify your account to check your line and plan details. Could you please provide one of the following:

- The phone number associated with your account,
- Your full name and date of birth,
- Or your customer ID?

Once I have this information, I’ll guide you through the steps to resolve your mobile data issues.
My name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. What do you need me to do next?

{"customer_id": "C1001", "full_name": "John Smith", "date_of_birth": "1985-06-15", "email": "john.smith@example.com", "phone_number": "555-123-2002", "address": {"street": "123 Main St", "city": "Anytown", "state": "CA", "zip_code": "90210"}, "account_status": "Active", "payment_methods": [{"method_type": "Credit Card", "account_number_last_4": "1235", "expiration_date": "12/2026"}], "line_ids": ["L1001", "L1002", "L1003"], "bill_ids": ["B1001", "B1002", "B1003"], "created_at": "2025-01-15 10:30:00", "last_extension_date": null, "goodwill_credit_used_this_year": 25.0}

Thank you for providing your information. To begin troubleshooting your mobile data issues, I’ll need you to perform a few diagnostic actions on your phone. This will help identify the cause of the slow or unreliable data connection.

Are you able to check your phone’s status bar and let me know:
- If you see any icons like Airplane Mode, signal strength bars, or network type (e.g., 5G, 4G)?
- If your phone shows “Data Enabled” or “Data Disabled”?

If you’re not sure how to check, let me know and I can guide you through the steps.
Status Bar: ✈️ Airplane Mode | 🔋 80%
I checked my phone’s status bar, and it looks like Airplane Mode is turned on. I don’t see anything about signal strength or data being enabled or disabled. What should I do next?

Airplane Mode disables all wireless connections, including mobile data, which is why you’re not seeing any signal or data indicators. To restore your mobile data:

1. Please turn off Airplane Mode on your phone.
2. Once Airplane Mode is off, check your status bar again and let me know if you see signal bars and a network type (like 4G or 5G).

If you need instructions on how to turn off Airplane Mode, let me know your phone model and I can guide you step by step.

Airplane Mode is now OFF.
Status Bar: 📶¹ Poor | 2G | 📵 Data Disabled | 🔋 80%
Okay, I turned off Airplane Mode. Now I see one bar for signal strength, it says 2G, and it shows that data is disabled. What should I do next?

Thank you for the update. Here’s what we need to address:

1. Your phone is currently connected to a 2G network, which is very slow and not suitable for excellent internet speed.
2. Mobile data is disabled, so you won’t be able to use the internet until it’s enabled.

Let’s start by enabling mobile data on your phone. Please turn on mobile data in your phone’s settings. Once you’ve done that, let me know if you see “Data Enabled” in your status bar.

After that, we’ll work on switching your network mode to a faster option like 4G or 5G.

Mobile Data is now ON.
Status Bar: 📶¹ Poor | 2G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔽 Data Saver | 🔋 80%
I turned on mobile data, and now the status bar says "Data Enabled," but it still shows only one bar for signal strength and says 2G. I also see something about "Data Saver." What should I do next?

Great job enabling mobile data! Since your phone is still on a 2G network and “Data Saver” is on, let’s address both issues to improve your speed:

1. Please switch your network mode to prefer 4G or 5G (if your phone supports it). This is usually found in your phone’s settings under “Mobile Network” or “Cellular Network,” then “Preferred Network Type.” Select “4G/5G Preferred” or the highest available option.

2. Turn off “Data Saver” mode. This is typically found in your phone’s settings under “Network & Internet” or “Data Usage.” Disable “Data Saver” to allow full-speed data.

After making these changes, check your status bar again and let me know:
- What network type you see (e.g., 4G, 5G)
- How many signal bars you have
- If “Data Saver” is still showing

This will help us see if your speed improves.

Preferred Network Mode set to: 4g_5g_preferred
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔽 Data Saver | 🔋 80%

Data Saver Mode is now OFF.
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%
I changed the network mode to prefer 4G/5G and turned off Data Saver. Now my status bar shows four bars for signal strength, says 5G, and Data Saver is no longer showing. What should I do next?

That’s excellent progress! With four bars of signal strength and a 5G connection, your phone should now be capable of excellent internet speeds.

To confirm everything is working as expected, please try using your mobile data to browse the web or stream a video. If you notice any issues or if the speed is still not excellent, let me know and we can run a speed test or continue troubleshooting.

Is your internet speed now meeting your needs, or would you like to check further?
Speed Test Result: 275.00 Mbps (Excellent). Connection is very fast.
I just ran a speed test, and it says my connection is excellent with very fast speeds. This is exactly what I wanted—thank you so much for your help!
I’m glad to hear your connection is now excellent and you’re getting the speeds you need! If you have any more questions or need help in the future, feel free to reach out. Have a great day!
Thank you! I really appreciate your patience and help. Have a wonderful day! ###STOP###
